# Invoice payment deadlines

Payment deadlines by client: fifteen days, thirty days, or on receipt. Deadlines are written on the invoice and in the calendar. When the deadlines pass, the reminders go out on a fixed schedule. Late payment deadlines can be extended once without a fee; deadlines are reviewed each quarter.
